NOTES:
- `AllowedMove` has no `requires_reason` flag. The reason textarea is always shown and becomes required once the server returns a `reason_required` 400.
- The sign-off confirm dialog appears when the selected move has `signoff_min != null`.
- The history effect also depends on `item.pending_signoff`, so it re-fetches after the board refreshes.
- Not covered: after a sign-off that doesn't commit, the panel updates counts from the response and sets `eligible_to_sign` to false. I didn't check what the board does on the next refresh.
